post.description: Public registration (RF-01). Only emails from the allowed UAL domains, with phone and acceptance of the rules and privacy policy. Nothing is created yet: the data waits as a pending registration and a 6-digit code is sent to the email. The account is created, without profiles, when the email is verified (POST /api/auth/verify-email). Registering again with the same email replaces the pending registration.

Checks the 6-digit code sent by email when registering (valid for 15 minutes). If it is right, the email is verified and a session is opened. After 3 wrong attempts the code is cancelled and a new one must be requested.
post.summary: Verify the email with the code and log in

post.description: Sends a new code and cancels the previous one, at most once a minute. Always answers 202, so it does not reveal which emails are registered.
Opens a new session (RF-02): returns an access token (15 min) and a refresh token (7 days, at most 30 days since login). Only users with a verified email can log in.
Exchanges the refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. Each refresh token works once: reusing it closes the session. Clients must not send two refreshes at the same time.
Closes the session of this device. Does not require the access token, and also answers 204 for an unknown refresh token.
Sends a 6-digit code (valid for 15 minutes) to the email if it has an account, at most once a minute; also used to resend it. Always answers 202, so it does not reveal which emails are registered.
Checks the code without using it up, so it must be sent again to set the new password. Wrong codes count as attempts: after 3 the code is cancelled and a new one must be requested.
Uses up the code, sets the new password (it must be different from the current one) and closes every open session of the user.
post.summary: Set a new password with the code
